premise.claim: Issue #4518 / PR body: users need to create a Runtime without pre-defining a Dataset; today strict Dataset-Runtime binding means a runtime without a dataset just waits.
premise.evidence: Differential: scripts/premise_base_test.go (compile-on-base copy) fails on base 25531595 (no Dataset created; runtime waits in the 'No dataset can be bound to the runtime, waiting.' 5s loop) and the equivalent behavior exists on head 63f43e2. See results/base-premise-p0.out and results/unit-f4-deletion-churn-head.out (65 pre-existing specs pass).
match: auto-creates the Dataset for an annotated Runtime with no Dataset
must not auto-create a Dataset for a Runtime that is being deleted

liveNote: L3 (needs a real cluster with GC and a real Fluid install): create a JuiceFSRuntime with fluid.io/dataset-policy=auto-create, no Dataset; expect the juicefs controller pod to crash-loop with 'index out of range' in the reconcile stack (transform -> genEdition). Deleting the auto-created Dataset should show the GC cascade to the runtime (ownership cycle). Not run in this round.
